independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored no implementation in the reviewed scope (tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, the CI workflow, agent definitions, analysis). My only writes are this record, its findings and verifications sidecars, and my evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-21/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-21 review record.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before reviewing
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --stat 9e3c27f..HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --ref 9e3c27f
checks_run.environment: repository working tree, agent shell sandbox (process sandbox + Bash sandbox), node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: candidate sha256:7d00f857...b5f270; commits after 9e3c27f are metadata-only
checks_run.actual: HEAD a0e077d (later 8d6fe6c, the domain run's auto-commit). The only post-freeze commit changes assignments, the manifest and stages.json. The working tree and --ref 9e3c27f both give sha256:7d00f8574a41648a4e9e9c7af97dc0e251db398a6251f6738a783c6fdcb5f270 (91 files).

checks_run.procedure: D-037 commitPresent(): a PRESENT fix_revision / head_commit_at_start that fails ancestry or containment is still an error
checks_run.command: git diff a23c4d4..9e3c27f -- tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs; node docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-21/r21-commitpresent-probe.mjs /home/user/My-owns (P3 case b); unit test 'D-037 / F-DG0-242'
checks_run.expected: A present commit lacking the manifest is rejected; a present fix not in the candidate is rejected
checks_run.actual: P3(b): a head at the present root e8361b8 is rejected with 'does not contain ...ef3ec3f205ffdac3.manifest.json' under both the D-037 and the round-20 rules. The unit test's present-but-later fix is rejected. The tolerance is not a blanket skip for present commits.

checks_run.procedure: Try to exploit the D-037 absent-commit tolerance with fabricated, missing or malformed values; census of real absent commits
checks_run.expected: Only a well-formed, genuinely unavailable commit in a superseded round is tolerated
checks_run.actual: head_commit_at_start as a non-existent 40-hex, missing, or 'not-a-sha' is accepted under D-037 in any round, including the gate round; the round-20 rules rejected all three (F-DG0-159). fix_revision is schema-checked (^[0-9a-f]{40}$), but a fabricated 40-hex id is accepted even for a gate-round closure; the unit test itself accepts '0'x40. Closure integrity rests on the run-bound reviewer verification, not on fix_revision. Census: 64/91 CLOSED_VERIFIED fixes absent; 3 (F-DG0-226/227/228) with the verifying round's source_commit present; no absent heads in rounds >= 13. The clone reports shallow=true (see C09).

checks_run.procedure: D-037 objectType(): gate source_commit must be a commit object reachable from HEAD (F-DG0-241) on the real repository
checks_run.expected: on-branch commit accepted; off-branch commit, annotated tag, tree and absent id rejected
checks_run.actual: 9e3c27f accepted. 450c756 (backup branch) rejected 'not a commit reachable on this branch'. Annotated tag 7dd0a54 rejected '(tag)', tree rejected '(tree)', absent id rejected '(absent)'. The D-036 missing-commit test and the D-037 unit test pass (C10).

checks_run.procedure: collectVerifications record-less handling: a record-less verifications sidecar can never close a finding; one whose <role>.json exists but is unlisted is still an error
checks_run.command: code review of tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs:614-661 and 664-702; unit test 'D-037 / F-DG0-243'
checks_run.environment: frozen commit source; node --test in a fresh clone
checks_run.expected: Record-less verifications are only skipped (never produce a closure); an existing record file that is unlisted errors
checks_run.actual: A record-less sidecar hits 'continue' before any entry is added to `out`, so it can only remove verifications, never add a closure. checkClosure still requires a verification whose record is listed and run-bound. With the record file present, the 'not listed in stages.json review_rounds' error returns (unit test passes). Residual effect: a record-less FAIL verification is ignored, equivalent to not committing the interrupted run at all.

checks_run.procedure: collectRaisedFindings/checkFindings record-less handling: can a finding raised only by a record-less sidecar be dropped from findings.json undetected?
checks_run.command: node docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-21/r21-recordless-drop.mjs /home/user/My-owns; node .../r21-recordless-supersede.mjs /home/user/My-owns; python census of raised vs referenced ids
checks_run.environment: disposable --no-local clones under $TMPDIR with a drafted APPROVED gate; D-037 rules versus round-20 rules (a23c4d4)
checks_run.expected: Deleting an imported finding from findings.json is always an error
checks_run.actual: Deleting imported F-DG0-239 (record-less round-18 qa sidecar) gives 0 errors about it; the round-20 rules gave 1 'dropped' error. The same holds with it re-statused OPEN: 'unresolved (OPEN)' disappears on deletion. Supersede variant: a forged record-less round-22 sidecar re-listing High F-DG0-242 clears its 'dropped' error; only the round-20 record's findings[] listing still catches it. Only F-DG0-238/239 are raised without being listed in any record. F-DG0-158.

checks_run.actual: RECORD-LESS 0, DROPPED 0, head-at-start 0, gate-candidate fix 0. But 2 permanent errors remain: 'finding F-DG0-150/151 (Low): fix 421c922233 is not in the verified round-18 candidate (450c756f67)'. Both commits are present (the harness mislabels them PRUNED). The OTHER bucket otherwise holds the expected pending items (open round-20 findings, F-DG0-147/149 awaiting the auditor, round-21 requirements not yet checked). F-DG0-161.

checks_run.expected: The validator detects or refuses shallow history; a write-once tamper is caught regardless of depth

checks_run.procedure: Residual 7 accuracy: /proc/sys write reachability from the agent shell and from nested sandboxes (open O_WRONLY then close, nothing written)
checks_run.environment: agent shell (uid 0, NoNewPrivs 1, own PID namespace); nested bwrap 0.9.0
checks_run.expected: Residual 7 describes every write vector; the comment's mechanism is right
checks_run.actual: The shell can open vm/swappiness, kernel/shmmax, net/ipv4/ip_forward, vm/drop_caches and kernel/panic for write (host-global). sandbox-run.sh's layout refuses them (EROFS) through its explicit --ro-bind; a plain nested --proc does not. There is no /proc/sysrq-trigger on this kernel. Impact class as disclosed; vector and mechanism wording off (Low F-DG0-162).

summary: FAIL. D-037 fixes F-DG0-241 correctly, and the commitPresent() tolerance still catches present-but-wrong commits. My F-DG0-157 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. However, the D-037 record-less exemption lets an imported finding from an interrupted run be deleted from findings.json with no validator error (F-DG0-158, Medium, mandatory). The repository is shallow, not 'pruned', and the validator never detects it, so write-once and the commit tolerances depend on clone depth (F-DG0-160, Medium). The F-DG0-150/151 re-point leaves a permanent gate error in clones that carry the backup branch, while single-branch clones pass (F-DG0-161, Medium). Lows: head_commit_at_start accepts missing or malformed values (F-DG0-159); residual 7 omits the direct shell vector and the comment names the wrong mechanism (F-DG0-162); the schema validator lets prototype-named keys through (F-DG0-163). Tests (97 node + 22 python) and the fresh-clone pre-freeze pass.
